title: Siemens SICAM A8000 RTU

defensive_actions: Update to SICAM A8000 CP-8031 V4.90 or later
countermeasures: Update to SICAM A8000 CP-8031 V4.90 or later

Conduct security audits of OCPP implementations
defensive_actions: Upgrade to OCPP 2.0.1 with Security Profile 3
Conduct security audits of OCPP implementations
countermeasures: Upgrade to OCPP 2.0.1 with Security Profile 3
